get.summary: Latest translated MarketTwits news (newest first)
get.description: Latest translated MarketTwits news (newest first), limit 1-50

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items (newest first)

get.summary: High-importance news only (newest first)
get.description: Only importance=high MarketTwits news (newest first), limit 1-50

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items (newest first)

get.summary: Keyword search in translated news (newest first)
get.description: Case-insensitive keyword search in translated MarketTwits news (all words must match), limit 1-50

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items (newest first)

get.summary: Keyword alert check: how many matching items in the last N hours
get.description: Count of news matching q (same matching as /news/search) published in the last N hours (1-168, default 24), plus the 5 most recent

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168)

get.summary: Short extractive English summary of the latest news on a keyword
get.description: 3-5 sentence extractive summary of the latest news matching q (limit 1-50, default 10): lead sentence + de-duplicated headlines, high-importance first

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of latest matching items to summarize (default 10, max 50)

get.summary: Top 5 keywords/hashtags in high-importance news of the last N hours
get.description: Top 5 topics (hashtags, names, keywords; counted once per item) across high-importance news of the last N hours (1-72, default 6)

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 6, clamped to 1-72)

get.summary: Extractive English summary of news on a keyword from the last N hours
get.description: 3-5 sentence extractive summary of news matching q published in the last N hours (1-168, default 12; up to 50 items), with high_count. Use for 'what happened with X today'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 12, clamped to 1-168)

get.summary: Is there new HIGH-importance news on a keyword in the last N hours?
get.description: Checks only importance=high news matching q in the last N hours (1-168, default 6): has_new, count and the latest item. Cheap poll for market-moving alerts on a topic/ticker.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 6, clamped to 1-168)

get.summary: Trending topics in high-importance news with change vs. the previous window
get.description: Top 5 topics (hashtags, names, keywords; counted once per item) in high-importance news of the last N hours (1-72, default 6), each with prev_count in the previous equal-length window, change = count - prev_count, and latest_id/latest_source_url

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 6, clamped to 1-72)

get.summary: Incremental feed: items newer than the id you already have (cursor polling)
get.description: All stored items with id > id (oldest first, up to limit 1-100, default 50) plus next_id/has_more for the next call. The cheapest way for a bot to poll without duplicates: keep next_id and pass it back.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Last item id you already have (0 = from the oldest stored item). Items with a larger id are returned, oldest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items per page (default 50, max 100)

get.summary: Top gainers/losers reported in the news ('#TICKER = ±X%')
get.description: Parses '#TICKER [Name] = ±X%' price-move mentions (stocks, indices, crypto; RU/US/... from the flag) in news of the last N hours (1-72, default 6), newest mention per ticker, |move| >= min_pct (default 0): top 10 gainers and top 10 losers with the source item.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 6, clamped to 1-72)

parameters.name: min_pct
parameters.description: Minimum absolute move in percent (default 0, max 100), e.g. 3 or 2.5

get.summary: News about one country (flag emoji + country keywords) with counts and top topics
get.description: Items of the last N hours (1-168, default 24; importance all|high|medium|low) that carry the country's flag emoji or mention it (e.g. RU: Russia/Kremlin/Bank of Russia/MOEX; US: USA/Fed/White House): count, high_count, share_of_window, top_topics and the 10 latest headlines.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, RU, CN, UA, IR, GB; UK = GB; EU accepted)

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168)

parameters.name: importance
parameters.description: Importance filter (default all)

get.summary: Macro data and earnings vs. expectations: actual, expected, previous, surprise
get.description: Parses releases like 'US Pending Home Sales (Sep) = -7.3% m/m (exp. -0.5% / prev. +0.3%)' and earnings lines like '3Q REV. $14.58B, EST. $12.87B' from news of the last N hours (1-168, default 24; optional q filter): indicator, actual, expected, previous, unit, surprise (actual - expected), surprise_pct and direction above/below/inline.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional keyword filter (same matching as /news/search)

get.summary: Heuristic bullish/bearish tone of news on a keyword (lexicon, not a model)
get.description: Scores each item matching q in the last N hours (1-168, default 24) with a keyword/emoji lexicon (rise/beat/upgrade vs. fall/miss/sanctions, ⬆️/⬇️) plus explicit '= ±X%' moves, and returns bullish/bearish/neutral counts, score = (bullish - bearish)/count in [-1, 1], a label and examples. method is always 'heuristic'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168)

get.summary: Sectioned briefing: central banks, macro, energy, equities, crypto, geopolitics
get.description: Groups news of the last N hours (1-48, default 24) into central_banks, macro, energy, equities, crypto and geopolitics by keyword rules (an item may appear in several), each with count, high_count and up to 5 headlines (high first, then newest), plus top_topics of high items.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-48)

get.summary: Official Bank of Russia FX rates (RUB) with day-over-day change
get.description: CBR official exchange rates from cbr.ru XML_daily.asp for a date (default: the latest set) and optional currency codes: per currency nominal, value (RUB per nominal), per_unit (RUB per 1 unit), previous set's per_unit, change and change_pct. Cached 30 min (past dates 7 days).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Rates date YYYY-MM-DD (default: latest set by CBR; 1992-07-01 .. tomorrow)

parameters.name: codes
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO currency codes (default: all ~55 CBR currencies), e.g. USD,EUR,CNY

get.summary: Bank of Russia key rate: current level, since when, and recent changes
get.description: Current CBR key rate (% p.a.) from the cbr.ru DailyInfo web service (KeyRateXML; the hd_base/KeyRate page as fallback): rate, as_of, effective_since, previous_rate, last_change_bp and every change in the last `months` (default 24) newest first, plus min/max in the window. Cached 3 h.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: History window in months for `changes` (default 24, max 120)

get.summary: Moscow Exchange stock quote (delayed ~15 min): price, change, volume, bid/offer
get.description: One MOEX shares-market ticker from MOEX ISS (main board TQBR when listed): price (last trade, or previous close before the session's first trade), change/change_pct vs previous close, open/high/low, bid/offer, volume, value_rub, market cap, trading status. Data is delayed ~15 minutes (delayed: true). Unknown ticker -> 404 (not settled).

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: MOEX ticker (SECID) on the shares market, e.g. SBER, GAZP, LKOH, YDEX, T

get.summary: MOEX index values (IMOEX, RTSI, sector indices) or the index catalogue
get.description: Index level, change/change_pct vs previous close, open/high/low, month/year change, annual high/low and traded value for up to 5 codes (default IMOEX), or code=list for the catalogue of MOEX stock indices (SNDX board + RTS*). Delayed ~15 minutes. Unknown codes -> 404 (not settled).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Index code(s), up to 5 comma-separated (default IMOEX; e.g. RTSI, MOEXBMI, MOEXOG), or `list` for the catalogue of stock indices

get.summary: Top gainers and losers on the Moscow Exchange main board (TQBR), with market breadth
get.description: Ranks TQBR shares by change vs previous close (turnover >= min_value RUB, default 5 mln): top `limit` gainers and losers (default 10, max 50), advancers/decliners/unchanged. Before the session's first trades (mode previous_session) it ranks the last completed session from ISS history. Delayed ~15 minutes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Gainers and losers to return (each side, default 10, max 50)

parameters.name: min_value
parameters.description: Minimum turnover in RUB to count a stock (default 5000000; filters illiquid names)

get.summary: Russian retail fuel prices (AI-92/95/98, diesel) — Rosstat weekly averages
get.description: Average retail pump prices across Russia from Rosstat's weekly release (rosstat.gov.ru nedel_sred_cen.xlsx): price (RUB/l), as_of, week-over-week change, 4-week and year-to-date change and `weeks` of history per fuel. Rosstat publishes weekly (usually Wednesday, prices as of Monday); cached 6 h, a stale copy (stale: true) is served for up to 14 days if Rosstat is unreachable.

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Weekly history points to include per fuel (0-52, default 4)

get.summary: Latest posts of a public Telegram channel (text, date, views, link)
get.description: Reads the public web preview t.me/s/<channel> (no login): newest `limit` posts (default 20, max 50) with id, date, text (HTML stripped, emoji kept), views, link, media types and channel title/subscribers. Channels without a public preview or that do not exist -> 404 (not settled). Cached 2 min.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Public Telegram channel username (5-32 chars; '@name' or a t.me link also accepted), e.g. markettwits

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Messages to return (default 20, max 50)

get.summary: Search up to 5 public Telegram channels for a keyword
get.description: Runs Telegram's own channel search (t.me/s/<channel>?q=) on 1-5 public channels, merges the matches newest first (up to `limit`, default 20) with per-channel counts/errors. 404 when no channel exists, 502 when all fail; partial failures are reported in per_channel.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.description: 1-5 comma-separated public channel usernames, e.g. markettwits,rbc_news

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Messages to return (default 20, max 50)

get.summary: Wildberries / Ozon product card: title, price (RUB), rating, reviews, stock
get.description: Live product data for a Wildberries (wildberries.ru, wb.ru) or Ozon (ozon.ru) product URL: title, current price in RUB (original_amount = list price before discount when known), rating, reviews_count and availability. Cached 10 min per product. If the marketplace blocks or fails, returns 502 upstream_unavailable and the payment is NOT settled. Can take up to ~40s when the live page has to be rendered.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product page URL: https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/<id>/detail.aspx (also wb.ru, *.wildberries.ru) or https://www.ozon.ru/product/<slug>-<id>/ (also *.ozon.ru)

get.summary: Compare 2-5 Wildberries products: prices, cheapest, price spread, stock
get.description: Fetches 2-5 product URLs (urls=comma-separated, or repeated url=) with the same live chain as /product/info and returns per-item title/price/original_price/in_stock/rating/reviews_count, the cheapest and most expensive item, price_diff (abs RUB and percent of the cheapest), in_stock_count and all_in_stock. Items that fail carry error/detail; returns 502 (payment not settled) only if fewer than 2 items returned a price.

parameters.name: urls
parameters.description: 2-5 comma-separated product URLs (Wildberries; Ozon is accepted but currently blocked by its anti-bot). Alternatively repeat url= instead.

get.summary: Price-target check for one product: is the current price at or below target_price?
get.description: Fetches one Wildberries/Ozon product (same live chain as /product/info) and compares it with target_price (RUB): below_target (current <= target and not out of stock), current_price, diff_abs/diff_percent, in_stock, the full product object and checked_at. Use it as a paid poll for price alerts. If the product is out of stock with no price it returns 200 with below_target false, current_price null, in_stock false and a note; if no product data can be fetched at all it returns 502 and the payment is not settled.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product page URL: https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/<id>/detail.aspx (also wb.ru, *.wildberries.ru) or https://www.ozon.ru/product/<slug>-<id>/ (also *.ozon.ru)

parameters.name: target_price
parameters.description: Target price in RUB, a positive number (e.g. 1500 or 1499.90)

get.summary: Wildberries price history: weekly CDN points + observed + live price, min/max/avg, 30-day change
get.description: Price history for a Wildberries product: weekly points from WB's public price-history CDN (weekly_cdn), prices this service observed on earlier lookups (observed; in-memory, reset on restart), and the current live price (live). Returns points (oldest first), current, stats min/max/avg, change_30d (vs. the latest point at least 30 days old) and history_limited:true with a note when only the current price exists. Ozon has no public history (only live, currently blocked). 502 (not settled) only when no price at all is available.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product page URL: https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/<id>/detail.aspx (also wb.ru, *.wildberries.ru) or https://www.ozon.ru/product/<slug>-<id>/ (also *.ozon.ru)
